note: ERROR SHAPE, byte-faithful body. The response to a real service account with a real, valid api-intent token and not one permission granted. The read is REFUSED, not emptied: total loss of the grant returns this 403 rather than a well-formed 200 holding zero users, so the total-loss case is loud. Only a PARTIAL grant is quiet, and that case is deliberately not a fixture -- a truncated 200 and an honest smaller 200 are the same bytes.

body.detail: You do not have permission to perform this action.
